versions.content: Support operation cycles according to ISO 14229-1 Description: The diagnostic in AUTOSAR shall provide a configurable set of system cycles that may qualify the event in an additional manner. Rationale: Operation cycles are essential for event status management. AppliesTo: CP, AP Dependencies: – Use Case: Starting of an operation cycle triggers many types of system reactions. Supporting Material: ISO 14229-1 v.2013 and ISO 15031-5
